Hi Ellen / Solvex procurement,

Quick note to start the renewal conversation before your contract rolls on July 1. I pulled your usage and see you’re trending ~2.3x YOY for inference tokens and latency-critical workloads — understood you wanted to discuss both a capacity uplift and pricing stability. High-level ask:

- Add capacity (target +2x dedicated GPU pool for peak inference).

Procurement timeline: we need final commercial terms by June 15 to get approvals for a July 1 effective date. Any flexibility on a 12→18 month term in exchange for deeper discount? Also, please confirm SOC2 evidence will remain available (security questions are in parallel).

Alex — good framing. Sales Ops reviewed usage and runway. We can approve a constrained concession structure to enable the renewal without escalating to CRO. Proposed commercial terms to present on the call:

Summary (presentable to customer):
- 12-month term (July 1 start): 10% discount on the committed uplift band (up to 2x current committed capacity) and a one-time onboarding credit of $25,000. Price hold on the existing per-token rate for 12 months.
- 18-month term: 15% discount on uplift and $40,000 onboarding credit; price hold for 18 months.
- Overage: capped at list price minus 5% for any usage beyond committed uplift; we will provide monthly true-up reporting.
- Burst protection: 3-month burst credits equivalent to $15,000 available after committed capacity is in place (non-transferable).

Conditions / operational asks:
- Solvex to provide a 30‑day rolling forecast for peak windows and a 60‑day notice for planned sustained increases above 3x baseline.
- No retroactive changes to committed bands once SOW is signed.
- SOC2 artifacts: Security will confirm retention & evidence access; include security contact on the next thread.

I attached a short terms summary (Solvex_Uplift_Terms_v2.pdf) — use that as the basis for the call. If customer prefers Option B (18 months) we can fast‑track a larger onboarding credit but need executive approval if total concessions exceed $60k.

Marissa Cole
Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Quick finance/legal note for the record:

- Deal id SOLVEX-2027-067 assigned.
- Finance approves the 12‑month (10% / $25k credit) and 18‑month (15% / $40k credit) structures as long as SOW includes the forecast & true-up cadence outlined by Sales Ops.
- Price hold must be limited to the SKU(s) referenced in the SOW — we cannot blanket‑hold every future SKU or add-on. Overage rule (list price minus 5%) is acceptable.
- Require procurement to sign the SOW + a short amendment that documents the onboarding credit schedule and the true-up mechanics.

Alex — please confirm you have Solvex acceptance on one of the two term options by June 15. If they pick 18 months and we exceed $60k total concessions, route to ELT for final sign-off.
